name: player_refresh_hud_from_state
description: Player::RefreshHudFromState refreshes shield, nanite, alternate weapon-bank, selected weapon, and mode-counter HUD state from a player save state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native Player HUD refresh tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4231b0 validates statusMeterValue divided by the local player's masterCommonData->maxHealth, forwarding nanitePanelLevel, iterating ten alt weapon banks, selecting left/right variants from enabled flags and ammo values, clearing disabled slots while preserving visible ammo text, refreshing active alt and primary selected weapon displays, and mapping amphib/hover/sub unlock flags to mode-counter states.

The native Player HUD refresh smoke verifies shield ratio and meter text, nanite forwarding, representative left/right/disabled weapon-bank display paths, active selected weapon display state, and mode-counter image selection.
